title: Global Digital Health Index and Monitor Maturity Scoring
text: whodigitalhealthmonitor provides standardized tools structuring, validating, scoring, visualizing digital health ecosystem maturity across seven /ITU eHealth Strategy Framework components 19 core indicators (plus sub-indicators) defined Global Digital Health Index (GDHI) / Global Digital Health Monitor framework.

title: Global Digital Health Index and Monitor Maturity Scoring
text: Install development version whodigitalhealthmonitor GitHub:

what: Quick Start with Your Own Data
title: Global Digital Health Index and Monitor Maturity Scoring
code: library(whodigitalhealthmonitor)  # 1. Inspect the 7 components, 19 core indicators, and sub-indicators dict <- gdhi_indicator_dictionary() head(dict)  # 2. Convert raw WEF Network Readiness Index scores (1.0-7.0) to Indicator 15 phases (1-5) wef_to_phase15(c(2.8, 3.6, 4.5, 5.2, 6.0))  # 3. Map custom column names from an imported CSV/Excel table to canonical GDHI IDs raw_survey <- tibble::tibble(   entity = c("Region_A", "Region_B"),   q1_governance = c(4, 2),   q2_planning = c(3, 2),   q3_strategy = c(4, 2),   q13_architecture = c(3, 1),   q15_network = c(4, 3),   q17_scaled_apps = c(4, 2) )  clean_data <- gdhi_map_columns(   raw_survey,   mapping = c(     IND_01 = "q1_governance",     IND_02 = "q2_planning",     IND_03 = "q3_strategy",     IND_13 = "q13_architecture",     IND_15 = "q15_network",     IND_17 = "q17_scaled_apps"   ) )  # 4. Compute component-level and overall maturity phases scores <- gdhi_score_maturity(clean_data, id_col = entity) scores  # 5. Visualize component maturity profile gdhi_plot_components(scores, id_col = entity)

what: Score GDHI Maturity Phases Across Components and Overall Ecosystem — gdhi_score_maturity
title: Score GDHI Maturity Phases Across Components and Overall Ecosystem — gdhi_score_maturity
text: Validates 1–5 indicator scores gdhi_indicator_dictionary() computes component-level overall digital health maturity phases.

title: Score GDHI Maturity Phases Across Components and Overall Ecosystem — gdhi_score_maturity
code: gdhi_score_maturity(   data,   id_col,   round_phase = TRUE,   include_subindicators = TRUE )

title: Score GDHI Maturity Phases Across Components and Overall Ecosystem — gdhi_score_maturity
text: data data frame tibble containing entity identifier column indicator score columns matching indicator_id values gdhi_indicator_dictionary() (example IND_01, IND_02, ..., IND_19, optional sub-indicators like IND_09A IND_19A). id_col Name entity/country/region identifier column (unquoted). round_phase Logical; TRUE (default), rounds component overall mean phases upward using ceiling(), matching GDHI phase aggregation conventions. FALSE, returns unrounded numeric means alongside raw scores. include_subindicators Logical; TRUE (default), includes sub-indicator columns present data averaging within parent indicator component. FALSE, uses core indicators .

title: Score GDHI Maturity Phases Across Components and Overall Ecosystem — gdhi_score_maturity
text: tibble id_col, component_number, component_name, component_mean, component_phase, overall_score (unrounded overall_raw_mean round_phase = FALSE).
